-- Check GA-9, GA-10 fix
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, primary_winner, pct_reporting
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district IN (9, 10);

-- Check OR districts 1-5 fix
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status, primary_winner, pct_reporting
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code = 'OR' AND district IN (1,2,3,4,5);

-- Check for any other write-in issues across all states
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status
FROM house_races
WHERE candidate1_name LIKE '%write%' OR candidate2_name LIKE '%write%'
LIMIT 10;
